fl: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

name: Totodile

atk.x: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Totodile but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

fl: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

name: Unown [L]

fl: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.
ru: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

name: Unown [S]

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at 1 of your Prize cards. Return that Prize card face down. This power can be used even if Unown [S] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

fl: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.
ru: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

name: Unown [T]

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand and show your hand to your opponent. This power can be used even if Unown [T] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

fl: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.
ru: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

name: Unown [V]

ab.x: When you play Unown [V] from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name (other than Unown [V]) to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

fl: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.
ru: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.

name: Venonat

atk.x: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

fl: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

name: Vulpix

atk.x: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Vulpix in order to use this attack.

fl: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

name: Broken Ground Gym
ru: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Each player pays Colorless more to retreat a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon.

name: EXP.ALL
ru: Attach EXP.ALL to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

During your opponent's turn, if your Active Pokémon would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, you may take 1 of the basic Energy cards attached to your Active Pokémon and attach it to the Pokémon with EXP.ALL attached to it. If you do, discard EXP.ALL.

name: Impostor Professor Oak's Invention
ru: Look at your opponent's Prize cards. You may have your opponent shuffle them into his or her deck. If you do, your opponent takes that many cards from the top of his or her deck and sets them aside as his or her new Prize cards (without looking at them).

name: Radio Tower
ru: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may look at the top 2 cards of his or her deck and put them back in the same order.

name: Thought Wave Machine
ru: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, return an Energy card attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to your opponent's hand. If the Pokémon has fewer attached Energy cards than that, return all of them to your opponent's hand. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

name: Counterattack Claws
ru: Attach Counterattack Claws to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

During your opponent's turn, if the Pokémon Counterattack Claws is attached to is your Active Pokémon and an opponent's attack damages it (even if it is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, discard Counterattack Claws.

name: Energy Amplifier
ru: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Energy Stadium
ru: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player puts a basic Energy card from his or her discard pile into his or her hand.

name: Lucky Stadium
ru: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.
Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player draws a card.

name: Magnifier
ru: Attach Magnifier to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Magnifier. If the Pokémon Magnifier is attached to attacks, don't apply Resistance for that attack.

name: Pokémon Personality Test
ru: Put an Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is a Pokémon card with Light in its name, a Pokémon card with Dark in its name, or neither one. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds
ru: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. Then, your opponent may draw up to 2 cards.

name: Heal Powder
ru: Flip a coin. If heads, your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned and remove 2 damage counters from it. If your Active Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

name: Mail from Bill
ru: You can't play this card if you have 5 or more cards in your hand (including this one). Draw cards until you have exactly 4 cards in your hand.

name: Shining Celebi

atk.x: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

fl: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Celebi in your deck.

name: Shining Charizard

atk.x: Discard 1 Fire Energy card and 1 Lightning Energy card attached to Shining Charizard or this attack does nothing. Flip a coin. If tails, Shining Charizard does 30 damage to itself.

fl: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Charizard in your deck.

name: Shining Kabutops

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and Shining Kabutops does 10 damage to itself.
Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Shining Kabutops but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Don't apply Resistance.

fl: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Kabutops in your deck.

name: Shining Mewtwo

atk.x: If an attack does damage to Shining Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn (even if Shining Mewtwo is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shining Mewtwo from that attack (any other effects of attacks still happen) and do 20 damage to the attacking Pokémon.
Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Mewtwo or this attack does nothing. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

fl: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Mewtwo in your deck.

name: Shining Noctowl

atk.x: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If exactly 2 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If all 3 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

fl: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Noctowl in your deck.

name: Shining Raichu

atk.x: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to Shining Raichu. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Raichu in your deck.

name: Shining Steelix

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, Shining Steelix can't attack during your next turn.

fl: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Steelix in your deck.

name: Shining Tyranitar

atk.x: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, your opponent discards the top card from his or her deck.

Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar or this attack does nothing. Then, for each heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and discard it. If it has fewer Energy cards than that, remove all of them.

fl: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.
ru: You can't have more than 1 Shining Tyranitar in your deck.
